meta.title: Ravi Varujana — Full-Stack Engineer
meta.description: Full-Stack Software Engineer with 4.5 years building Node.js/NestJS microservices, real-time systems, and payment, KYC and compliance workflows. Based in Bangalore, India.

profile.name: Ravi Varujana
profile.intro: Full-stack engineer (Node.js/NestJS, React, PostgreSQL) with 4.5 years owning systems end to end: payment and verification workflows, third-party integrations, event-driven sync between systems, and automation that replaces manual work. I build with AI coding tools like Claude Code and Cursor as a default part of designing, debugging and shipping.

whatsapp.message: Hi Ravi, I came across your portfolio and would like to connect.

about.title: I own systems end to end.
paragraphs: From the data model and API to the integrations, background jobs and admin workflows people use to run it. I like problems where a manual process can become code, and where systems have to stay in sync without anyone checking.

At Gammastack I build backend services for a production iGaming platform: 3 independently deployed services on PostgreSQL and Redis, with Kafka streaming events to an external CRM. Around that sit payments, identity verification, a rules layer on every transaction, a bonus engine and background workers.

Before that I built Node.js APIs and server-side payment validation for a US client's sales CRM at Qodic Technosoft, and NestJS microservices and React microfrontends for enterprise clients at Nagarro. AI tools are part of how I work every day, and I'm now learning to build AI features into the systems themselves.

focus.title: Integrations & system sync
focus.text: Third-party APIs (Veriff, Layer1) and Kafka event streaming that keeps an external CRM in sync.

focus.title: Payments & verification
focus.text: Multi-currency payments, multi-level KYC with admin approval, and server-side validation before money moves.

focus.title: Automation over manual work
focus.text: Queue workers with retries and monitoring, scheduled syncs and rule-driven workflows.

focus.title: Data & performance
focus.text: SQL query rewrites and indexing (70%+ lower latency), schema design with Prisma.

points: Engineered **Node.js** backend services for a production iGaming platform spanning casino, sportsbook and real-time multiplayer features, running as 3 independently deployed services backed by PostgreSQL and Redis, with **Kafka** for event streaming to an external CRM.
Reduced API latency by **70%+** on high-traffic endpoints via **PostgreSQL** query rewrites and targeted indexing.
Scaled **Socket.IO** horizontally across Node.js instances via the **Redis** adapter, removing a single point of failure.

Built a server-side **Responsible Gambling** layer that intercepts every bet and deposit to enforce configurable bet and loss limits, session time caps and self-exclusion, meeting regulatory requirements.
Implemented a multi-level **KYC** pipeline on **Veriff** APIs, automating identity and document verification with an admin approval and escalation workflow.
Integrated **Layer1** for multi-currency crypto payments, with scheduled exchange-rate sync replacing manual updates.

Designed a rule-driven bonus engine unifying **5** reward types (joining, referral, deposit, cashback, wagering) behind one extensible workflow that also automates **VIP tier** progression from player activity.
Moved ad-hoc scripts into an independently deployed **Bull (Redis)** worker with retries and Bull Board monitoring.
Built **Node.js** REST APIs for a custom sales CRM (US client), covering user management and activity tracking.
Enforced transaction limits and server-side validation on offer purchases, rejecting invalid payments before processing.
Built a reusable payment UI component library (**React**, **Tailwind CSS**, lazy loading) shared across client projects.
Migrated a legacy **React** codebase from class components to functional components and hooks.
Built and maintained scalable **microservices** using **NestJS** following Domain-Driven Design, serving multiple enterprise clients with high reliability.
Designed REST APIs and relational schemas with **Prisma ORM**, using transactions and constraints for consistency.
Developed **React** modules in a microfrontend architecture, so teams could own and deploy UI modules independently.
Wrote **Jest** test suites and **Redocly** API docs, reducing regressions and speeding up third-party integrations.
Reviewed code and mentored junior developers; promoted from Associate to Software Engineer.

caseStudies.title: PostgreSQL query tuning & indexing
caseStudies.summary: PostgreSQL query rewrites and targeted indexing on high-traffic endpoints cut API latency by more than 70%.

details.heading: Context
details.body: High-traffic API endpoints on a production iGaming platform, backed by PostgreSQL.

details.heading: What I did
points: Rewrote the slow PostgreSQL queries behind those endpoints.
Added targeted indexes for the access patterns they needed.

details.heading: Outcome
details.body: API latency on those endpoints reduced by 70%+.

caseStudies.title: Event streaming to an external CRM
caseStudies.summary: Kafka streams events from the platform's services to an external CRM, so customer data stays in sync across systems without manual exports.

details.heading: Context
details.body: A production iGaming platform running as 3 independently deployed services on PostgreSQL and Redis, with an external CRM that needed the same customer events.

details.heading: What I did
points: Streamed platform events to the external CRM through Kafka.

details.heading: Outcome
details.body: The CRM stays in sync with the platform without manual exports.

caseStudies.title: Multi-currency crypto payments
caseStudies.summary: Layer1 integration for multi-currency crypto payments, with scheduled exchange-rate sync replacing manual updates.

details.heading: What I did

caseStudies.title: Bull queue worker service
caseStudies.summary: Ad-hoc scripts moved into an independently deployed Bull (Redis) worker with retries and Bull Board monitoring.

details.heading: Context
details.body: Background work was running as ad-hoc scripts, with no retries or monitoring.

details.heading: What I did
points: Moved the scripts into a Bull (Redis) worker, deployed independently from the main API.
Added retries and Bull Board monitoring.

details.heading: Outcome

caseStudies.title: Bonus engine & VIP tiers
caseStudies.summary: A rule-driven engine unifying 5 reward types behind one extensible workflow, which also automates VIP tier progression.

caseStudies.title: Horizontally scaled Socket.IO
caseStudies.summary: Socket.IO scaled horizontally across Node.js instances through the Redis adapter, removing a single point of failure for live player features.

details.heading: Context
details.body: Live player features ran on Socket.IO, and a single instance was a single point of failure.

details.heading: What I did
points: Scaled Socket.IO horizontally across Node.js instances.
Connected the instances through the Redis adapter so events reach clients on any instance.

details.heading: Outcome
details.body: Real-time features run across multiple instances, with no single point of failure.

caseStudies.title: Reusable payment UI library

points: Built reusable payment UI components with React and Tailwind CSS.
Lazy-loaded components to keep bundles small.

details.heading: Outcome
details.body: Shared across client projects instead of rebuilt for each one.

caseStudies.title: This portfolio
caseStudies.summary: Designed and built with AI coding tools as the default workflow: a React 19 site driven by one JSON file, with a serverless contact form protected by Cloudflare Turnstile.

details.heading: Context
details.body: I wanted a portfolio I could update in minutes and that shows how I work, not just what I've worked on.

details.heading: What I did
points: Built it with Claude Code as a pair: design direction, implementation, testing in a real browser at phone and desktop sizes, and iteration.
Kept all content in a single typed JSON file, so updating it never means touching components.
Wrote the contact form backend as a Cloudflare Pages Function that verifies a Turnstile token and drops honeypot submissions before emailing me.
Made it accessible and fast: keyboard navigation, reduced-motion support, no layout shift, and a ⌘K command menu.

details.heading: Outcome
details.body: A live, maintainable site, and a concrete example of shipping with AI tools end to end.

learning.title: AI-first in how I work, still learning how to build with it.
learning.intro: AI tools are part of my daily workflow. Building AI features into backends is what I'm learning next, focused on where it meets the systems I already build: services, data, queues and APIs.

tracks.title: AI-assisted engineering, every day
tracks.text: Claude Code, Cursor and ChatGPT for designing, coding, debugging, testing and prototyping. This portfolio was built that way.

tracks.title: LLM features in Node.js services

tracks.title: Retrieval on PostgreSQL

tracks.title: AI workloads on queues
tracks.text: Running slow, failure-prone AI jobs through queue workers with retries and visibility, the same way I run background jobs today.

tracks.title: ML fundamentals in Python
tracks.text: The core ideas behind models and data pipelines, so AI features are designed rather than bolted on.
